topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I can't stop thinking about this time capsule we found. It's like, where did it come from? Who put all those things in there? Every item just pulls at me, like they're pieces of a puzzle we're supposed to solve. I keep rummaging through everything, hoping to find a clue, some tiny hint that could unravel this mystery. It's gnawing at me, this need to know. What if it’s something important, something someone wanted to hide? We have to figure this out, can't just let it go. There's a story here, and I'm not sleeping until we know what it is.
